SIR epidemic on a 20x20 grid torus

A susceptible-infected-recovered epidemic spreading across a 20×20 grid whose edges wrap.

What to watch for

Color is the state of an individual, not its identity. Watch infection cross the seam at the edge of the grid — on a torus the far side is a neighbor, so an outbreak that reaches the boundary does not stop there.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (36 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
